offences.quote: Do not present material produced by generative AI as your own work, as this is an academic integrity breach.
offences.anchor: How to use Generative AI with integrity

offences.quote: Ghost writing/contract cheating - when we submit work written or rewritten by another party, in part or whole, as our own.
offences.anchor: How do I use generative AI responsibly and ethically?

offences.quote: Plagiarism - when we submit words or ideas copied, in part or whole, from other sources without acknowledgment
